verdict.rationale: Lever's AI features page says AI Interview Transcripts and Summaries automatically capture interview conversations and generate recaps to speed up feedback, which covers the recording, transcription and summary core of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows those summaries feeding the scorecard, and candidate consent isn't mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit distillation of summaries into scorecards, candidate consent/recording-disclosure handling, detail on recording mechanics (supported meeting tools), independent or hands-on corroboration.
